description: Humanitarian Response and Conflict Events: from a place or crisis to a cited dossier of ReliefWeb situation reports and appeals, HDX dataset revisions with HXL tags, and UCDP conflict events with each coder's precision codes and release history, as of a date, over shared Geospatial, OSINT, News, Demographics, entity-identity, subscription and source-acquisition providers. Counts and codings are quoted as published; a place with no record has none on record; ACLED is not acquired (licence).

profiles.description: Place- or crisis-centred humanitarian evidence: what was published, by whom, as of when

vocabulary.situation report: a publisher's report as ReliefWeb lists it, cited by locator
vocabulary.dataset revision: one HDX metadata/resource state with licence, hashes and HXL tags
vocabulary.conflict event: one coder's coded event; precision codes and counts as published
vocabulary.event revision: the event as one coder release published it
